sources.title: TimeSformer - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview The TimeSformer model was proposed in TimeSformer: Is Space-Time Attention All You Need for Video Understanding? by Facebook Research. This work is a milestone in action-recognition field being the first video transformer. It inspired many transformer based video understanding and classification papers.
